description: Record that the customer paid an invoice outside Doing Work (check, cash, financing, insurance or other). Owner or office, or their agent. Closes the invoice, and the job too unless its checklists still block done (job_status says which; finish them and call jobs.complete). The job record says "Paid outside Doing Work", is never marked paid or verified, and no Doing Work receipt goes to the customer. There is no limit on jobs paid outside Doing Work and no fee on them. Agents can record these too unless the owner turned that off with shops.setAgentMoney.

note.description: Optional note for the shop, up to 500 characters. Not shown in the home record.

name: invoices_markPaidOutside
